description: KRON legacy 46-byte state, rebuilt in the test with kcc20.materializeKcc20Script from kcc20.addressPresenceOwned. The owner and type come from a real mainnet KASM UTXO whose 2732-byte redeem script begins with mainnet_state_prefix_hex. That prefix stops after the low four amount bytes (68 5b 01 00), so the amount assumes the upper four are zero; the template body around the state is synthetic.
